llms.body:
# Channel Talk

> AI agent platform for automated customer support

Channel Talk is an all-in-one AI messenger that automatically resolves customer inquiries with AI and unifies customer support, marketing, and team communication in one place. Used across 229,098+ active channels worldwide, including Eastarjet, Daewoong Pharmaceutical, Eland Eats, Skinfood, Verish, Coloso, and Amuse.

## Features

- **ALF** — AI agent for customer support. Handles everything from repetitive FAQs to order cancellations, returns, and address changes autonomously. Adopted by 3,000+ businesses with an average AI resolution rate of 65%.
- **Team ALF** — AI agent for internal work. Consolidates scattered internal knowledge in Documents and answers questions like an in-house ChatGPT.
- **Live Chat** — Unified inbox that integrates and manages all customer conversations from KakaoTalk, Naver TalkTalk, email, and more in one place.
- **Meet** — Quick phone number setup with flexible IVR configuration, automatic STT transcription, and AI call summaries.
- **Voice ALF** — ALF handles incoming customer calls directly, answering FAQs or routing to chat ALF to automate customer inquiries end-to-end.
- **Team Chat** — Internal team messenger with built-in AI.
- **Workflow** — No-code automation tool for designing and editing scenario-based chatbots.
- **Documents** — Knowledge management tool for creating and managing documents that ALF references, with easy web publishing to create a help center or blog.
- **Marketing** — CRM marketing tool that consolidates customer data including support history, order info, and visit count, with SMS, email, and KakaoTalk broadcast capabilities.

## Key Stats

- 229,098+ active channels worldwide
- 6M+ conversations resolved by ALF
- 65% average AI resolution rate
- 3,000+ businesses using ALF
- 98% service retention rate

## Security & Compliance

- ISMS certified (valid: 2026.08.02 ~ 2029.08.01)
- ISO 27001 certified
- AWS-based infrastructure
- G2 rating: 4.8/5

We're dead serious.","next-2026.hero.title":"Customer Support SaaS Is Dead.","next-2026.s1.p1":"In the 2010s, the CS bottleneck was clear. Customers called and waited on hold, agents logged records in spreadsheets, and managers compiled end-of-month reports. Channel.io replaced this process with real-time chat. When customers messaged directly from a website, agents responded instantly, and every conversation was automatically recorded.","next-2026.s1.p2":"That alone was a revolution. Endless hold times vanished, conversation history became searchable, and team collaboration became seamless.","next-2026.s1.p3":"But looking back, what we built was ultimately \u003cbold\u003ea faster support processing system\u003c/bold\u003e.","next-2026.s1.title":"The Problem We Solved","next-2026.s2.p1":"What businesses need isn't \"fast answers.\"","next-2026.s2.p2":"They want to know why revenue is dropping. They want to know why customers are churning. And once they know, they want to act immediately. Customer support SaaS could only intervene at the very last stage of this journey — after the customer expressed a complaint.","next-2026.s2.p3":"It was a fire extinguisher that responded after the fire broke out, not a system that prevented fires.","next-2026.s2.p4":"Meanwhile, the truly important data remains scattered.","next-2026.s2.p5":"Order data trapped in legacy admin panels. Customer information fragmented across CRMs. Revenue analysis buried in spreadsheets. Behavioral logs piling up in GA. And customer voices captured in chat support that no one systematically reads.","next-2026.s2.p6":"All of this sat disconnected, quietly rotting in their respective silos.","next-2026.s2.title":"Support Is the Tip of the Iceberg","next-2026.s3.p1":"Channel.io has always made decisions based on one criterion: Does this decision bring the business closer to its customers?","next-2026.s3.p2":"Even as tools change and software evolves, this criterion hasn't changed. We chose chat for the same reason we now choose AI — because it's the best decision for businesses to understand their customers more deeply.","next-2026.s3.p3":"Channel.io's AI agent ALF has been deployed to \u003cb1\u003eover 3,000 companies\u003c/b1\u003e and handled \u003cb2\u003e6 million\u003c/b2\u003e conversations. In the last 3 months, \u003cb3\u003e65%\u003c/b3\u003e of inquiries handled by ALF are resolved without human intervention. Well-operated teams reach up to \u003cb4\u003e90%\u003c/b4\u003e.","next-2026.s3.p4":"This isn't a story about efficiency. It's a story about enormous potential.","next-2026.s3.p5":"If agents are freed from simple inquiries, they can spend that time understanding customers more deeply. They can identify churn signals and patterns from thousands of conversations and discover what customers truly want.","next-2026.s3.p6":"\u003cb1\u003eKnowing your customers best means CS becomes the growth engine of the business.\u003c/b1\u003e But today's CS tools don't fully support this role.
